[2026-10-27 04:35 CET] Main 82258094c (PR #183, e-class cost context) is integrated at f61c306e7. The Nix rebuild and all 342 core examples pass. Changed formatting checks pass. The adapted constrained cost-5 witness still returns the accepted term; its exact 118-byte output is unchanged.

A verified progress limitation predates this API change. Use A = {a,u(A)}, Z = {z}, and bad(A,Z) with equal-child constraints, then merge with accepted leaf good. A lexicographic Integer-pair cost takes the maximum of the symbol base and child costs, then increments the second component. The base is (1,0) for good and (0,0) otherwise. This cost is monotone and strictly exceeds every child. Native acceptance returns Right True; size extraction returns Just (1,good); least-cost analysis returns Just (0,2); lexicographic extraction hits its internal two-second timeout. The source queue always has another cheaper rejected bad candidate before good at (1,1). The timeout alone is not a formal nontermination proof.

Reviewed documentation repair 1c2e0cb21 states finite generated partial terms at each cost bound as a sufficient progress condition. Executable code is unchanged. FINDINGS records the runnable witness and exact 108-byte timeout receipt, SHA256 c0d16e5248c616734d370648f6ac58e313fccb2d327255adbb38dc8379779564. Sorted returned results and progress remain separate obligations.

Local proof commits d66c342d5 and 0b2d3bcc6 derive completed paired assimilation and the actual flat cached terminal prefix. Final native counts and flags follow. Original old Safe, pending and native-realization gates stay explicit. No intermediate count invariant, prefix allocation bound or native Caller/intersection provenance is inferred. Fourteen new theorems pass strict checks; Audit passes 3996 jobs and 78255 dependency checks. Installed readback covers 16 signatures and seven definitions, with permitted axioms only.

Checkpoint evidence is being prepared for the authorized formalize push. Next compose the native fold with its actual Caller, memo, query and intersection history. H6 and captured rendering remain unchanged. Whole recursive soundness, discharge/rendering, coverage and completeness remain open. Note: lean/notes-current-flat-native-assimilation.md.
